metadata.title: Quantum Delayed Synchronization (QDS) - Hahn-Echo T2 Sweep on IBM Hardware
metadata.description: U-delay-U† (Hahn-echo) versus U-delay (control) T2 sweep on IBM Quantum hardware (ibm_kingston, qubit 91), 5 runs with 1024 shots per circuit. Includes raw counts, evaluated statistics, the circuit template SHA-256, the measurement chronicle and the referee limits.
